_comment: Copy to ~/.config/standup-ghost/secrets.json and `chmod 600` it. Tokens for the headless 'token' transport flavors ONLY — kept out of config.json so config can be echoed/shared freely. NEVER commit the real file (it is .gitignored).
_slack_bot_token_note: Slack bot token for flavors.slack="token". Scopes: canvases:read + canvases:write (canvas sink), chat:write (channel sink). The bot must be a MEMBER of the target canvas/channel. Create at api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions.
